parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes XI\. — La diadema de berilos {{#loco q:loco|—Holmes —dije una mañana, de pie en nuestro mirador, mientras miraba la calle—, ahí viene un loco.}} Parece bastante triste que su familia lo deje salir solo. {{#febrero q:febrero|Era una mañana de febrero, clara y fría, y la nieve de la víspera seguía espesa sobre el suelo, centelleando al sol de invierno.}} {{#franja_parda p:baker_street q:franja_parda|Por el centro de [[baker_street|Baker Street]] el tránsito la había arado hasta dejarla en una franja parda y desmenuzable, pero a los lados y en los bordes amontonados de las aceras seguía tan blanca como al caer.}} —¿Qué demonios le pasa? —pregunté—. {{#numeros q:numeros|Va mirando los números de las casas.}} {{#viene_aqui e:holmes q:viene_aqui|—Creo que viene aquí —dijo Holmes, frotándose las manos.}} Poco después estaba en nuestra sala, jadeando todavía, pero con una expresión tan fija de pena y desesperación en los ojos que nuestras sonrisas se trocaron al instante en horror y lástima. —Mi nombre —dijo nuestro visitante— probablemente les será familiar. {{#holder e:alexander_holder q:holder|Soy [[alexander_holder|Alexander Holder]], de la casa de banca Holder & Stevenson, de [[threadneedle_street|Threadneedle Street]].}}

src_en.loco: Holmes,” said I as I stood one morning in our bow-window looking down the street, “here is a madman coming along.
src_en.febrero: It was a bright, crisp February morning, and the snow of the day before still lay deep upon the ground, shimmering brightly in the wintry sun.
src_en.franja_parda: Down the centre of Baker Street it had been ploughed into a brown crumbly band by the traffic, but at either side and on the heaped-up edges of the footpaths it still lay as white as when it fell.
src_en.numeros: He is looking up at the numbers of the houses.
src_en.viene_aqui: I believe that he is coming here,” said Holmes, rubbing his hands.
src_en.holder: I am Alexander Holder, of the banking firm of Holder & Stevenson, of Threadneedle Street.
src_en.doble_linea: There was a double line of tracks of a booted man, and a second double line which I saw with delight belonged to a man with naked feet.
src_en.su_hijo: I was at once convinced from what you had told me that the latter was your son.
src_en.maxima: It is an old maxim of mine that when you have excluded the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
src_en.vagabundo: I went in the shape of a loafer to Sir George’s house, managed to pick up an acquaintance with his valet
src_en.seis_chelines: at the expense of six shillings, made all sure by buying a pair of his cast-off shoes.
src_en.encajaban: With these I journeyed down to Streatham and saw that they exactly fitted the tracks.
